correct_completion: the buses took a longer route.
full_sentence: Because the bridge was closed, the buses took a longer route.
acceptable_variants: the buses had to go around the city.
the drivers used a different road.

options.text: the bridge was closed on Monday.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the cause instead of giving the result, so it does not complete the cause-and-effect link.
'Although' signals contrast, but the stem needs a consequence of the closure, not a contrast.

options.text: the buses took a longer route.

options.why_wrong: This is unrelated to the closure; the stem needs a result that follows from the closed bridge.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause, so the main clause must show the result of that cause. Learners often confuse 'because' with 'although' because both start a subordinate clause, so check whether the sentence shows a cause or a contrast.
translation: Como el puente estaba cerrado, los autobuses tomaron una ruta más larga.
